latest_default_commit.message:
docs: document the Python API the live engines expose but the corpus lacked (#193)

A sweep of 20 console builds (PFC/FLAC/3DEC/MPoint, 6.0-9.7, 2D and 3D) dumped
itasca.* recursively and diffed it against what itasca_browse_python_api can
reach. Own-product families were missing on every engine, so agents could not
look up e.g. FLAC structural elements, PFC body thermal state or the 2D
orientation API, and some indexed entries had no doc at all.

scripts/corpus/reconcile_python_api_live.py adds, from the Sphinx pages with
the live __doc__ as fallback (2D-only and version-only members have no page):

- A. 81 modules: FLAC structure (+9.7 arrays), dfn, fish, history, data,
  geometry; PFC ball/clump/wall thermal, cfd, element.cfd, dfn, fish, history,
  geometry; MPoint dfn, fish, history; 3DEC 9.7 structure arrays, data, geometry.
- B. 33 members on documented objects: FLAC 2D interface length (the 6
  dangling quick_ref entries plus interfaceelementarray.length), FLAC 7.0
  names (Attach.master/slave, prop_scalar_set), PFC 2D rotation.
- C. availability.versions on 45 existing entries absent from some versions
  (e.g. 40 FLAC zonearray/gridpointarray functions not in 7.0), and a
  "3D builds only" note on the 48 PFC euler entries.

Only each engine's own families are added; itasca.util and _common are left
alone. Existing entries are untouched except fish.call_function, whose Sphinx
signature parsed into two bogus required params on every engine.

State-readback probes pinned behaviour the docstrings omit: FLAC interface
node length/area read 0 until the first cycle; FLAC3D 7.0 Node.has_prop/props/
set_prop always raise ValueError; PFC 2D rotation is in degrees and only
advances with orientation tracking on; fish.call_function needs a tuple.

The 3DEC/MPoint isolation tests asserted structure and dfn were 3DEC-only and
MPoint was core-only; structure is FLAC's own command family and dfn/fish/
history back each engine's fracture/fish/history commands, so the tests now
assert the real invariant (no block/flowknot/flowplane outside 3DEC, no
zone/gridpoint in MPoint).

# itasca-mcp-bridge [English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/itasca-mcp-bridge)](https://pypi.org/project/itasca-mcp-bridge/) Runtime bridge that runs inside an ITASCA product process (PFC, FLAC3D, 3DEC, MPoint, MassFlow) and exposes the product's Python SDK as an HTTP API, enabling execution tools for MCP servers such as [itasca-mcp](https://pypi.org/project/itasca-mcp/). The bridge is product-neutral: it drives the host through the shared ITASCA command language / Python SDK rather than any product-specific API. ## Features - **Async tasks with progress polling.** Submit a long simulation script (`execute_task` message) and poll its status and paginated output while it runs (`check_task_status`). - **Live REPL during a run.** Send `execute_code` against the running task's namespace at any time to inspect state or tune parameters mid-cycle — no need to bake probes into the script up front. - **Graceful interrupt.** Stop a long cycling task on request (`interrupt_task`) without killing the product. - **Unified output capture.** Python `print` and product console output (`itasca.command()` tables, list dumps, summaries) are interleaved in execution order in the task log. - **User console history.** What the person types into the product GUI — cells in the IPython pane and lines at the command prompt — is recorded with its output and handed to the client on request (`console_history`), so an agent sees what happened in the GUI between its own calls. - **GUI activity.** The plots and data files the person opens, closes or switches to, the items added to a plot, and the data files executed from the editor are recorded alongside, by name. ## Architecture ITASCA's Python SDK is main-thread-only, so the bridge keeps the simulation on the main thread and serves remote requests around it with three parts: ```mermaid flowchart TD C[MCP client] -->|HTTP + SSE| S[HTTP server
thread-per-request] S -->|submit → Future| Q[MainThreadExecutor
queue] Q -->|Qt timer / blocking poll| M[product main thread
itasca SDK + solver] M -.->|callback at cycle| CB[interrupt check
+ snippet executor] CB -.-> M ``` - **HTTP server (thread-per-request).** A stdlib `http.server` (no asyncio, no third-party dependency) serves each request on its own thread, hands the work to the main thread, and awaits a `Future`. It never touches the SDK directly, so lightweight calls (status, interrupt) stay responsive even while a long task runs. Request/response is plain `POST /`; the one server→client doorbell (`task_status_changed`) is pushed over a single long-lived `GET /events` Server-Sent Events stream. - **Main-thread queue.** `MainThreadExecutor` holds a thread-safe queue that the main thread drains — via a Qt timer in GUI mode, or a blocking poll in console mode. Submitted task scripts (`execute_task`) run here. - **Cycle-gap callbacks.** A cycling task holds the main thread, so two `itasca.set_callback` hooks keep it reachable: an interrupt check that stops the run (`interrupt_task`), and a snippet executor that runs `execute_code` REPL calls in the gaps between cycles — sharing the task's `__main__` namespace for live inspection and tuning. ## HTTP protocol The bridge is the source of truth for the wire contract — MCP servers such as itasca-mcp are clients of it. Each request is a `POST /` whose body is a JSON object carrying a `request_id`; the JSON response echoes the `request_id`. The server→client doorbells ride a single long-lived `GET /events` SSE stream (payload-free `task_status_changed` and `console_entry` events that prompt the client to re-poll), and `GET /health` is a liveness probe. The commands are product-neutral: | `POST /` | Purpose | Key body fields | |---|---|---| | `execute_task` | Submit a file-backed script as a tracked async task | `task_id`, `script_path`, `description` | | `check_task_status` | Poll a task's status and paginated log | `task_id`, `skip_newest`, `limit`, `filter_text` | | `list_tasks` | List known tasks | `offset`, `limit` | | `interrupt_task` | Request a graceful interrupt of a running task | `task_id` | | `execute_code` | Run a snippet in the running task's `__main__` (sync REPL) | `code`, `timeout_ms` | | `console_history` | Read what the person typed and did in the GUI since the last call | `limit` | ## Quick Start Run inside the product's Python (GUI IPython console or console CLI): ### Install from PyPI In the product's IPython console: ```python from pip._internal.cli.main import main as pip_main pip_main(["install", "--user", "itasca-mcp-bridge"]) import itasca_mcp_bridge itasca_mcp_bridge.start() ``` ### Headless, agent-launched A console build runs the data file passed as its first argument, so an agent can bring the stack up itself — no GUI, nobody at the keyboard: ```text model new python import itasca_mcp_bridge python itasca_mcp_bridge.start(mode="console") ``` ```console $ _console.exe start_bridge.dat # e.g. pfc3d900_console.exe, flac3d900_console.exe ``` `start()` does not return, so nothing after that line runs; everything else goes through the MCP tools. The bridge is stdlib-only (`http.server` + Server-Sent Events), so there is no third-party dependency to install or version-match — it lands cleanly in any ITASCA embedded Python (3.6+) with no pins. On every `start()` the bridge checks PyPI for a newer release (5-second timeout; the Tsinghua mirror is tried when pypi.org is unreachable) and self-upgrades before starting. The check is best-effort -- offline machines and failed installs fall back to the installed version. To pin the installed version, call `start(auto_upgrade=False)` or set the environment variable `ITASCA_MCP_BRIDGE_AUTO_UPGRADE=0`. Corporate mirrors can be configured with `ITASCA_MCP_PIP_INDEX_URL`. After a self-upgrade the banner is followed by a short "What's new" list of the release highlights you just received; call `itasca_mcp_bridge.whats_new()` to reprint it anytime. ### Run from a source checkout ```python %run C:/path/to/itasca-mcp-bridge/start_bridge.py ``` > Use forward slashes in the path. Do not wrap it in quotes. Code changes take effect on the next `%run`, so this is the preferred workflow during development. The bridge auto-detects the runtime: a Qt timer when the host is a GUI application, a blocking loop otherwise. The banner reports which pump won, so `Mode` is the first thing to check if a console start looks unreachable. Expected output: ```text ============================================================ Itasca MCP Bridge Server ============================================================ Version: 0.6.2 URL: http://localhost:9001 Log: /your-working-dir/.itasca-mcp-bridge/bridge.log Mode: Qt timer ============================================================ ``` ## Requirements - An ITASCA product with an embedded Python interpreter. Verified on PFC, FLAC3D, 3DEC, MPoint and MassFlow, GUI and console builds, across the 6.0, 7.0 and 9.x product generations. - Python >= 3.6 (6.0/7.0 products embed Python 3.6; 9.x products embed Python 3.10). - No third-party runtime dependency: the transport is stdlib-only (`http.server` + Server-Sent Events). ## Troubleshooting | Symptom | Fix | |---------|-----| | Server won't start | Re-run the install/start steps in the product's IPython console; check `.itasca-mcp-bridge/bridge.log` | | Port in use | `itasca_mcp_bridge.start(port=9002)`, then point your MCP client's bridge URL at `http://localhost:9002` | | Connection failed | Confirm the bridge is running and the port is reachable; see `.itasca-mcp-bridge/bridge.log` | | No task execution / MCP cannot connect | If execution tools return `ok=false`, `error.code=bridge_unavailable`, `error.details.reason=cannot connect to bridge service`, confirm `itasca_mcp_bridge.start()` is running and your MCP client's bridge URL matches | ## Relationship to MCP servers This package is the in-process runtime only. Pair it with an MCP server that speaks its HTTP protocol — for example [itasca-mcp](https://pypi.org/project/itasca-mcp/) — for full client setup. License: MIT.

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "itasca-mcp-bridge"
dynamic = ["version"]
description = "HTTP bridge for ITASCA products (PFC, FLAC3D, 3DEC, MPoint, MassFlow) - runs inside the product process to enable remote simulation control"
requires-python = ">=3.6"
license = { text = "MIT" }
authors = [{ name= "Yusong Han", email = "yusong.han.652@gmail.com" }, { name = "Nagisa Toyoura", email = "nagisa.toyoura@gmail.com" }]
keywords = ["itasca", "itasca-software", "pfc", "flac", "flac3d", "3dec", "mpoint", "massflow", "mcp", "simulation", "http", "bridge"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 4 - Beta",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.6",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.7",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.8",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
]
# No runtime dependencies: the bridge speaks stdlib HTTP + SSE (http.server),
# so it installs cleanly into any ITASCA embedded Python (3.6+) with no pins.
dependencies = []
readme = "README.md"

[project.scripts]
itasca-mcp-bridge = "itasca_mcp_bridge.__main__:main"

[tool.hatch.version]
path = "src/itasca_mcp_bridge/__init__.py"

工具清单 (10 个) 本项目继承了原版全部的 10 个 MCP 工具： **5 个文档工具** — 浏览和搜索 PFC 命令、Python API 和参考文档。不需要 Bridge 运行。 | 工具 | 用途 | |---|---| | `browse_commands` | 浏览 PFC 命令树 | | `query_command` | 搜索 PFC 命令 | | `browse_python_api` | 浏览 Python API | | `query_python_api` | 搜索 Python API | | `browse_reference` | 浏览参考文档 | **5 个执行工具** — 交互式 REPL、任务提交、进度监控、中断和历史。需要 Bridge 运行。 | 工具 | 用途 | |---|---| | `execute_code` | 在 PFC 中执行 Python 代码 (REPL) | | `execute_task` | 提交长时间运行的任务 | | `check_task_status` | 检查任务进度 | | `interrupt_task` | 中断运行中的任务 | | `list_tasks` | 浏览任务历史 | --- ## 与上游的差异 ### PFC 5.0 兼容性 | 模块 | 修改 | |---|---| | `_compat.py` | **核心兼容层** — 新增 `threading.get_ident`、`Future`、`TimeoutError`、`Queue/queue`、HTTP server、`urlopen`、`importlib.invalidate_caches`、`makedirs` 等 Python 2/3 桥接 | | `__init__.py` | `upgrade` 模块 import 异常保护 | | `runtime.py` | `python-reset-state false` 回退 PFC 5.0 语法 | | `file_buffer.py` | bytes→unicode 编解码保护 | | `command_log.py` | `program log` 不存在的兼容处理 | | `snippet.py` | 移除 `capture_pfc_console`；`thread.get_ident` 回退 | | `main_thread.py` | traceback 调用顺序修复 | | `execute_code.py` | 异常时完整 traceback 日志 | | `upgrade.py` | 全部使用 `_compat` 兼容层 | ### Windows 代理修复 | 文件 | 修改 | |---|---| | `bridge/client.py` | `httpx.AsyncClient(trust_env=False)` 禁用 Windows 系统代理自动检测 | ### 项目配置差异 | 项目 | 上游 | 本移植版 | |---|---|---| | Bridge Python 版本 | 3.6+ | **2.7+** | | MCP Server Python 版本 | 3.10+ | 3.10+（不变） | | PFC 版本 | 6.0 / 7.0 / 9.0 | **5.0** | | `auto_upgrade` | True (可联网升级) | **必须 False** (SSL 太旧) | | Qt timer 模式 | 支持 | 不支持，fallback 到 blocking poll | | 系统代理 | 需要手动处理 | `trust_env=False` 自动绕过 | --- ## 问题排查 ### Bridge 无法启动 ``` ImportError: cannot import name ... ``` **原因：** `addon.py` 的 `_import_bridge()` 删除模块缓存时只删了顶层模块， Python 2.7 的相对导入会因父子模块对象不匹配而失败。 **解决：** 确保使用本项目 `scripts/addon.py` 的最新版本， 它会在重载 Bridge 时清除所有子模块缓存。 --- ### SSL 连接错误 ``` SSLError: EOF occurred in violation of protocol ``` **原因：** Python 2.7.9 的 OpenSSL 太旧，无法与现代 PyPI 建立 TLS 1.2+ 连接。 **解决：** `start()` 时传 `auto_upgrade=False`，或用 `scripts/addon.py`。 --- ### 502 Bad Gateway **原因：** httpx 自动检测 Windows 系统代理，将 localhost 请求路由到代理服务器。 **解决：** 1. 给 MCP Server 的 `client.py` 打补丁（加 `trust_env=False`） 2. 或使用 `scripts/run_itasca_mcp.py` 包装脚本 3. 或设置环境变量 `NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,::1` --- ### 5057 MCP 工具不可见 ```bash claude mcp list ``` 如果显示 `✗ Disconnected`，重启 Claude Code 会话即可。 --- ### Qt 不可用 ``` Task loop running via blocking poll (interval=20ms) ``` PFC 5.0 不包含 PySide2/PySide6，这是正常现象。Bridge 会以 blocking poll 模式运行，不影响功能。 --- ## # itasca-mcp-common — Itasca MCP 共享包

> 为 3dec-mcp、flac3d-mcp、pfc-mcp、udec-mcp 四个 MCP 服务器提供共享基础设施：WebSocket bridge 通信、任务管理、文档索引、仿真模式库等。

> Shared infrastructure for 3dec-mcp, flac3d-mcp, pfc-mcp, and udec-mcp MCP servers: WebSocket bridge communication, task management, document indexing, simulation pattern library, etc.

## Modules / 模块

### `bridge` — WebSocket Bridge Client / WebSocket 桥接客户端

异步 WebSocket 客户端，用于与运行在 Itasca 软件 GUI 中的 `itasca-mcp-bridge` 通信。支持自动重连、任务状态推送监听、请求超时重试（区分"bridge 繁忙"和"连接断开"两种场景）。被 PFC、FLAC3D、3DEC 三个产品共享；UDEC 使用 TCP FISH socket 架构，不依赖此模块。

Async WebSocket client for communicating with `itasca-mcp-bridge` running inside Itasca software GUIs. Features auto-reconnect, task status push notification, and request timeout retry with distinct handling for "bridge busy" vs "connection lost" scenarios. **当前状态：0.1.1源码版，已完成一次d0有限真实闭环验证。** 2026年10月21日本机新计划完成基线1次及反馈候选2次，共9条三围压曲线，全部从new并通过离线验收，自动重试0。基线J=0.038726002621036044；bb_e基线-0.5%/+0.5%候选的J分别为0.039911884592736764/0.040696688575581064，均回退，保留基线。该计划预算3/3已关闭，不能继续借用。43项软件测试通过，PFC侧35份源码经独立Python2.7.9编译与中文请求编码回归。

随包默认配置和计划仍关闭真实许可，下载代码不构成模型执行授权。真实模型提交实际使用CLI→HTTP bridge；官方MCP适配已对真实成果完成摘要读取和离线验收，但其submit工具仍明确禁用，不能称本轮三次模型由MCP提交。验证不代表全局最优、AI提高寻优效率或其他PFC版本已通过。公开分发只含代码、示例配置和必要说明，不含实测目标、运行曲线或PFC存档。下面的“本轮停止门”等示例描述安全默认状态，不是重启本机已关闭预算的入口。
本包首版以Windows、PFC3D 5.0、内嵌Python2.7.9及d0单组三围压案例为已整理范围；标准目标每压76点，覆盖0至15%轴向应变。不要将它理解为任意PFC版本、任意试验或任意目标格式的通用优化器。
Agent决定候选 → 运行Python/CLI → 受控核心核验批准及输入
→ 本机HTTP bridge → PFC主线程执行 → 磁盘成果
CLI就是在宿主终端执行的`python -B -m triaxial_agent ...`命令。它不是人工代替Agent选参数；Agent仍负责读反馈和提出候选，固定程序负责计算及安全检查。该路径已经完成本机三次真实三压验证，不要求每个模型请求再经过MCP服务器。

本包MCP的模型提交工具仍明确禁用；这不代表MCP协议不能提交模型，也不代表CLI没有使用MCP项目提供的bridge。两条路径复用的是同一个固定PFC5兼容bridge来源。旧三轴已核查宿主入口同样存在CLI直接HTTP提交，不能把脚本名中的mcp或HTTP路由`/execute_task`当作MCP协议调用证据，也不能反推项目历史上从未使用MCP工具。首版以CLI计算主线加可选MCP辅助接口交付，不将尚未验证的MCP模型提交作为已完成功能。
pfc_runtime/         PFC Python2.7模型执行器和ASCII入口
tests/               合成与模拟测试，不执行真实PFC
third_party/         固定PFC5兼容bridge及完整许可和哈希
宿主标定核心仅使用Python标准库；MCP是独立可选依赖。图件制作环境和本机真实数据不属于核心安装要求。
## 2. 环境准备：先选对Python
宿主与PFC内嵌Python是两个环境。宿主建议使用本包实际检查的Python3.12；PFC5内嵌环境仍是Python2.7.9，不能把本包宿主模块直接粘贴到PFC控制台运行。
以下PowerShell示例在代码包根目录执行。把PythonHost改为自己已安装的宿主Python实际位置；WindowsApps里的python别名不等于可用解释器。
$PythonHost = 'C:\Python312\python.exe'
& $PythonHost -B scripts/environment.py doctor
& $PythonHost -B -m triaxial_agent doctor
& $PythonHost -B -m triaxial_agent validate
doctor不启动PFC、不探测bridge；validate校验唯一配置与有限计划，不创建模型任务。
& $PythonHost -B scripts/environment.py setup --env-dir ..\.runtime_env\client_01 --mcp-extra
setup拒绝已有同名目录，不改系统PATH、PFC安装、旧bridge或Agent全局配置。固定版本和下载哈希见requirements-mcp.lock；核心不使用pip安装任何PFC SDK。若安装失败，保留记录并使用新环境名，不删除或覆盖旧环境。
## 3. 先跑一次完全不需要PFC的软件示例
& $PythonHost -B -m triaxial_agent generate-demo --output ..\demo_01
& $PythonHost -B -m triaxial_agent score --targets ..\demo_01\targets.csv --simulations ..\demo_01\simulations.csv --output ..\demo_score_01 --classification synthetic_software_validation_only
& $PythonHost -B -m triaxial_agent prepare --targets ..\demo_01\targets.csv --output ..\run_01 --classification synthetic_software_validation_only
& $PythonHost -B -m triaxial_agent summary --run ..\run_01
这些命令只生成合成数据、离线评分及未提交请求。示例曲线是数学函数构造，不是实测或PFC计算。每个输出目录必须不存在，第二次演示请更换编号。
`model_sources/calibration_plan.json`描述基线、可调参数、离散步长、预算、改善规则及真实执行许可。模型数值与允许改变的范围是两件事，不能通过编辑请求跳过计划。
| 命令 | 是否写文件 | 是否访问PFC |
| wait-files | 只读磁盘，有限等待 | 不查询PFC任务 |
| submit-mock | 写模拟提交意图和收据 | 只允许独立软件模拟服务 |
| submit | 新有限计划明确获批后写单次意图及收据；默认拒绝 | CLI路径已真实验证，只有新批准、哈希、工作区及PID全部通过才连接bridge |
使用`python -B -m triaxial_agent <命令> --help`查看准确参数。离线不等于只读，特别是verify可能创建新验收文件。没有真实或明确模拟终态时，verify应失败，不得制造complete。
1. `validate --config ... --plan ...`检查新输入；`prepare --targets ... --config ... --plan ... --output ... --ascii-workspace ...`冻结全新基线，不运行PFC。
2. 按第8节在独立PFC5 GUI中启动一次console bridge。核对实际监听PID、版本、组别及ASCII工作区；端口监听成功本身不等于身份正确。
3. `submit --run ... --pid ...`只提交一次。读取本轮真实pending收据后，不调用PFC状态接口，不重复提交。
例如，第3步的命令形状为`python -B -m triaxial_agent submit --run <本轮新ASCII工作区> --pid <已核验PFC进程ID>`。尖括号是说明占位符，不是可直接运行的值；请先用各子命令的`--help`填写实际路径和必需的父证据参数。
